title: geocarpon cumberlandense
intro: Geocarpon cumberlandense, commonly known as Cumberland rosemary, is a small, annual or biennial plant native to the southeastern United States. It is defined as a plant that produces a small, flower-like structure called a geocarpon, which is a type of vegetative reproduction. The plant has been found to have potential health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Geocarpon cumberlandense include its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, and may have applications in the treatment of various health conditions, including cardiovascular disease and cancer.
